name: Metadata Enricher
description: Add title, source path, page number, author and ingestion time to document metadata, separating what was extracted from what was computed and never inventing a value.
install: Optional PDF document info: pip install pypdf. Without it enrichment still runs, because enrich() never reads a file. Copy with: ragkit add metadata-enricher
missing_dependency_message: metadata-enricher needs no package to enrich. pypdf is optional and only requested by read_document_info(); install it with pip install pypdf if you want title and author pulled from a PDF's document information.
